description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Songs” illustrates how three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—vary as a function of relation/answer popularity. The x-axis is labeled “Answer Popularity,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 10 to 160, with regularly spaced tick labels at 20-unit intervals (20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, and shows tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The Accuracy series is drawn as a solid blue line with circular markers, starting near 0.55 at popularity 10, dipping to about 0.48 at 20, rising to ~0.76 at 40 and ~0.82 at 50–60, slightly decreasing to ~0.80 at 75, peaking around ~0.88 at 95, and ending around ~0.84 at 120 and remaining near ~0.84 at about 155. The Confidence series is a solid green line with upward triangle markers, beginning around ~0.92 at 10, staying near ~0.90–0.92 through 30, increasing to ~0.95 at 40 and ~0.97 at 50–60, remaining near ~0.97 at 75, reaching approximately ~0.98 at 95, then sitting around ~0.96 at 120 and finishing near ~0.97 at about 155. The Alignment series is a solid red line with square markers, starting near ~0.63 at 10, dropping to ~0.58 at 20, rising to ~0.61 at 30 and ~0.81 at 40, reaching ~0.85 at 50–60, decreasing to ~0.83 at 75, increasing to about ~0.90 at 95, decreasing to ~0.85 at 120, and ending near ~0.87 at about 155.
